title: Young African American Man with Arm Cast on Stairs, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
To Eri,
Love
George La Bae

049 B
description: A deckle-edged mid-1950s black-and-white snapshot capturing a smiling young African American man, signed as George on the reverse, standing on an outdoor or architectural staircase. He wears a short-sleeved plaid patterned shirt tucked into dark pleated trousers, with a prominent white cast or bandage wrapped around his left wrist and forearm. High-contrast sunlight creates soft lens flare and shadow drama across the composition. The reverse features an intimate handwritten dedication inscribed in ink: 'To Eri, Love George La Bae'.
